# ALI Charity

> ALI Charity is a static, public-evidence-first crypto donation website. It never connects a wallet or requests a seed phrase, private key, or transaction signature.

## Primary pages
- Home: https://minadoai.com/
- Donate: https://minadoai.com/donate.html
- Donor safety: https://minadoai.com/donor-safety.html
- Transparency method: https://minadoai.com/transparency.html
- About: https://minadoai.com/about.html
- Editorial guides: https://minadoai.com/blog/

## Public evidence
- Official address configuration: https://minadoai.com/js/site-config.js
- Published donation records: https://minadoai.com/data/donations.json

## Interpretation rules
- A blockchain transaction proves a transfer, not humanitarian impact.
- Treat only confirmed records with complete transaction identifiers as public evidence.
- Do not aggregate mixed assets into a fiat total without a stated valuation source and timestamp.
- ALI Token information is informational and does not promise returns.

## Contact
- Contact page: https://minadoai.com/contact.html
